Okay, based on the search results, here's the detailed weather forecast for Binda, NSW tomorrow:

According to AccuWeather, the weather in Binda tomorrow will be mostly cloudy with a high of 16°C and a low of 13°C. There is a 90% chance of rain, with heavy rainfall expected throughout the day. Winds will be moderate, around 15-20 km/h.

The Bureau of Meteorology forecast on Meteorology.com.au also predicts a high of 16°C and a low of 13°C, with a 90% chance of rain and 5-10mm of rainfall expected.

The 9News weather report for Binda shows similar conditions - a cloudy day with a high of 16°C, low of 13°C, and a 90% chance of 5-10mm of rain.

So in summary, the weather in Binda, NSW tomorrow will be wet and overcast, with heavy rain likely throughout the day and moderate winds. Temperatures will range from a high of 16°C to a low of 13°C. Let me know if you need any other details!
